accountDescription: Review the signed-in identity and manage credential security.
changePasswordDescription: Verify the current password before setting a new one. Every device must sign in again afterward.
passwordPolicy: Use 8–256 ASCII letters, numbers, or symbols. Spaces are not allowed.
passwordTooShort: The new password must contain at least 8 characters.
passwordTooLong: The new password cannot exceed 256 characters.
passwordInvalidCharacters: The new password may contain only ASCII letters, numbers, and symbols; spaces and non-ASCII characters are not allowed.
passwordMismatch: The new passwords do not match.
genericError: The operation failed. Please try again.
revokeAllDescription: Sign out of Neo Chat on this device and every other device.
revokeConfirm: Sign out on every device? This page will return to sign in too.
unavailableDescription: This feature is available after Server Auth is enabled and you sign in.
